question: Which secret yoginī is invoked through the mantra containing the command to delude and the seed syllable klīṃ?
premises: The formula includes the imperative repetition mohayamohaya.
The formula includes the seed syllable klīṃ and ritual endings namaḥ svāhā.
The colophon identifies it as the root mantra of Rahasya Yoginī.
inference: This transmitted formula is the root mantra of Rahasya Yoginī.
plain_english: “Mohana mohana, klīṃ, namaḥ svāhā” — thus is the root mantra of Rahasya Yoginī.
